text_block_list.text:
It happened after today's training was 
over, right after I walked <chrname> back to the 
dorms.
(Murmur, murmur... murmur, murmur...)
choice_data_list:
(Is it noisier over by the school 
gate...?)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Just a moment is all I need! If I could 
just confirm the facts with you!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me, no! You're causing a 
disturbance to the students, so please 
take your leave!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer...! You can't, don't come out 
right now!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't that that trainer everyone's 
talking about?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me! Are you Trainer <username>?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Are the rumors true that you are putting 
your Umamusume through overly harsh 
training!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Rumors like making them run laps until 
midnight, sitting on a stone for three 
days straight, or doing handstand laps 
around the track...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
But an exposé article has already been 
published!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That is why I have been explaining to you 
for a while now that the article is 
complete nonsense...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Are you certain it's untrue? The trust of 
the entire Tracen Academy is on the line!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Halt! Halt, I say—!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I must vehemently! Object to that premise 
first! There is absolutely no one at our 
academy who would bring suffering to our 
beloved Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And! The academy will soon issue an 
official statement regarding this matter!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
To all members of the media, please! I 
implore you to hold your patience and wait 
on standby!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. Please make sure to let me 
interview you next time."

With Chairwoman Akikawa's commanding word, 
the reporters reluctantly dispersed, 
despite their dissatisfaction...

Afterward, according to Reporter Otonashi, 
who came to the Chairwoman's office during 
the strategy meeting—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...And so, as a result of focusing too 
heavily on seeking cooperation from 
numerous media outlets, quality control 
fell behind.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
As a result of fabricated articles 
circulating, unwarranted suspicions have 
fallen upon Trainer <username>...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I am terribly sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Absolved! This is not on Otonashi-kun 
alone!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That's right! At the end of the day, the 
person who writes those weird articles is 
the most at fault!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm! However, now that things have 
escalated this much, bringing the 
situation under control will be 
difficult...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Once a misunderstanding spreads, it's 
difficult to completely clear it up..."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm! On the Academy's part, ensuring the 
students' safety is of utmost urgency!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, perhaps we really 
should suspend media press permissions for 
the time being...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: ...! Pl-Please wait!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
There are no excuses for what happened. It 
was simply because I wasn't strong enough!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
However, without Tracen Academy's 
cooperation, we cannot hold the Twinkle 
Star Climax...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, we will not cut off all 
cooperation! It is just that for now, we 
should scale back media coverage until 
public opinion settles down—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Public interest settling down means the 
world has completely forgotten about you!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Mmh...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Of course, the reporter and the outlet 
that published those fabricated articles 
will never be allowed near any race ever 
again!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I know it's a selfish request...! But 
please, won't you let us continue our 
reporting as we have before?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
We do not want the excitement around the 
"Twinkle Star Climax" to fade away.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"...This new race is meant for Umamusume 
who possess the strength worthy of being 
called 'the strongest.'"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Robbed of the title of "Strongest" by a 
twist of fate, yet possessing undeniable 
strength... Such Umamusume, too, can grasp 
the ultimate glory...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why, when they seize 
victory, it must be at the absolute peak 
of excitement! I want to make it the 
grandest spectacle possible!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I will take full responsibility for this 
situation and do everything in my power to 
bring it to a close. So please, I beg of 
you...!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Query! In that case, how does Ms. 
Otonashi intend to bring the situation 
under control?!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Your passion has reached me loud and 
clear! However! As Chairwoman of Tracen 
Academy, I cannot grant approval on 
enthusiasm alone!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...I would like you to allow me to conduct 
an interview.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
An interview? Hmm, bewildering... To go 
from discussing media regulations to being 
interviewed ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
We'll call it... 'Up Close and Personal 
with Trainer <username>'!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Yes! By reporting on it every day, we can 
broadcast these wonderful training 
sessions to the entire world.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"I figured if we did that, it would serve 
as proof that we aren't engaging in 
problematic conduct like reckless 
training...!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And what's more, it can even serve as 
publicity! You really thought this 
through... You have my sincere praise!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If Reporter Otonashi handles it, perhaps 
it won't be much of a burden on the 
Trainers.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It's just, um... Reporter Otonashi, aren't 
you very busy right now preparing for the 
new race?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"If you suddenly couldn't make it and were 
replaced by another reporter halfway 
through, that would be..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
No, no matter what happens, I will cover 
it. Even if every bone in my body is 
broken, I'll crawl if I have to!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Because I believe taking responsibility 
means doing just that...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If every bone in her body is shattered, 
I'd really want her to go to the hospital, 
though... What should we do, Chairwoman?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm. That is true... Naturally, I shall 
bear the responsibility on the Academy's 
side, but...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Question! Trainer <username>, what is it that you 
want to do?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I am convinced that as <chrname>'s partner, you are 
the only one who can decide this!

For a moment, I'm at a loss for words. A 
stable training environment or cheers from 
the crowd— which one is truly better for <chrname>?

True, Reporter Otonashi's knowledge would 
be a powerful weapon. However, can I truly 
trust her—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...Please... Just let me chase my dream a 
little longer...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Good morning! We look forward to covering 
your story up close starting today!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"...To think you would truly give your 
permission. Truth be told, I am a bit 
surprised."
choice_data_list:
Because I didn't want to shut the door on 
anyone's dreams

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Huh? A dream... you say?
choice_data_list:
No, not at all. I look forward to working 
with you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! I will do everything I can not to 
get in your way!

I still don't know what Reporter 
Otonashi's dream is. However, to deny her 
desire to chase that dream would be—

It felt as though I would be turning my 
back on the dream I swore to chase 
together with <chrname>.

"...And so began the days of being closely 
covered by Reporter Otonashi!"
